extracted.intended_audience: Users of GAP (mathematicians and computational algebraists) constructing and computing with Lie algebras in GAP
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP functions and attributes for constructing, inspecting, and computing with Lie algebras, root systems, Weyl groups, restricted Lie algebras, adjoint representation, universal enveloping algebras, finitely presented Lie algebras, and Lie algebra cohomology.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingRingElement
rubrics_metrics.description: Let obj be a Lie object constructed from a ring element r by calling LieObject(r). UnderlyingRingElement(obj) returns the ring element r used to construct obj.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If r lies in family F then obj lies in LieFamily(F). Example shows retrieving underlying matrix and comparing operations on obj vs. underlying element.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieAlgebraByStructureConstants
rubrics_metrics.description: Creates a Lie algebra from a structure constants table (same argument meaning as AlgebraByStructureConstants), returning an algebra assumed to be a Lie algebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The function does NOT check whether the provided structure constants satisfy the Jacobi identity; using an invalid table may cause errors later.

rubrics_metrics.name: RestrictedLieAlgebraByStructureConstants
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs a restricted Lie algebra from structure constants plus an explicit p-mapping given as a list (pmapping) describing p-th powers of basis vectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As with LieAlgebraByStructureConstants the function does not check the Jacobi identity, nor whether pmapping specifies a legitimate p-mapping; pmapping entries follow SetEntrySCTable format.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieAlgebra (from associative algebra / gens)
rubrics_metrics.description: LieAlgebra(L) forms the Lie algebra isomorphic to associative algebra L as a vector space with Lie bracket as product; LieAlgebra(F, gens[, zero][, "basis"]) builds the Lie algebra over division ring F generated by gens (wrapped as Lie objects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The returned algebra elements are Lie objects (wrapping the provided vectors); if "basis" is given, gens are known to form an F-basis; when gens are ring elements they're wrapped into the Lie family of the containing family.

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a free Lie algebra of given rank over ring R, or with named generators; elements are written on the Hall–Lyndon basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators can be accessed with GeneratorsOfAlgebra; examples show nested Lie products and expansion.

rubrics_metrics.name: FullMatrixLieAlgebra / MatrixLieAlgebra / MatLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs the full matrix Lie algebra of n×n matrices over ring R (the Lie algebra formed from matrix commutator).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to create standard matrix Lie algebras; example creates a Lie algebra over finite field GF(9).

rubrics_metrics.name: RightDerivations / LeftDerivations / Derivations
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the matrix Lie algebra of derivations of an algebra A with respect to a basis B: RightDerivations represent right action, LeftDerivations represent left action (transpose relationship), Derivations is synonym for RightDerivations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Description of matrix entries: RightDerivations matrix [d_{i,j}] means D(b_i) = sum_j d_{i,j} b_j; LeftDerivations matrices are transposes of RightDerivations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SimpleLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs (attempts to construct) a simple Lie algebra of given type string ("A","B","C",...,"M") and rank n over field F, with type-specific constraints and notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type-specific requirements: types A–G require n positive integer; some types require n to be lists with parity constraints; some types exist only in characteristic p>0; Chevalley basis returned in characteristic zero for A–G; note that in some cases returned algebra may not be simple (e.g., An when p divides n+1).

rubrics_metrics.name: LieCentre / LieCenter
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lie centre of L is the kernel of the adjoint mapping: { a in L : for all x in L, a x = 0 }.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In characteristic 2 this may differ from the usual centre (elements commuting with all others), hence the distinct name LieCentre; returns two-sided ideal when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieCentralizer
rubrics_metrics.description: The annihilator (centralizer) of subset S in Lie algebra L: { a in L : for all s in S, a * s = 0 }, where S may be a subspace or subalgebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute centralizers of subalgebras or subspaces; returns a Lie algebra object in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieNormalizer
rubrics_metrics.description: The normalizer NL(U) of subspace U in L: { x in L : [x, U] ⊂ U }.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns the normalizer as a Lie algebra; used to find stabilizers of subspaces under adjoint action.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieDerivedSubalgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: The (Lie) derived subalgebra of L (subalgebra generated by all commutators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns the derived subalgebra object; example shows computing dimension for a matrix Lie algebra.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieNilRadical
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculates the (Lie) nil radical of the Lie algebra L (maximal nilpotent ideal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a two-sided ideal when present; examples illustrate use for small dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieSolvableRadical
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the (Lie) solvable radical of L (maximal solvable ideal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns two-sided ideal; example shows for FullMatrixLieAlgebra(Rationals,3).

rubrics_metrics.name: CartanSubalgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: A Cartan subalgebra of L is a nilpotent subalgebra equal to its own Lie normalizer in L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CartanSubalgebra(L) computes such a subalgebra when applicable; example for simple Lie algebra G2.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieDerivedSeries
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the (Lie) derived series of L (iterated derived subalgebras until trivial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a list of Lie algebras forming the derived series; example shows series of dimensions decreasing to 0.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieLowerCentralSeries
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the (Lie) lower central series of L (iteratively [L, previous term]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a list of Lie algebras representing the lower central series; used to detect nilpotency.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieUpperCentralSeries
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the (Lie) upper central series of L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a list (ideals/subalgebras) showing central series growth; examples illustrate returned two-sided ideals.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLieAbelian
rubrics_metrics.description: Property test returning true if every Lie product of elements in L is zero (L is abelian as a Lie algebra).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows constructing a Lie algebra by zero antisymmetric structure constants to get true.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLieNilpotent
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if L is nilpotent, i.e., its Lie lower central series reaches the trivial subalgebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to test nilpotency; examples construct small Lie algebras shown to be nilpotent.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLieSolvable
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if L is solvable, i.e., its Lie derived series reaches the trivial subalgebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to test solvability; examples illustrate usage with structure-constant-created algebras.

rubrics_metrics.name: SemiSimpleType
rubrics_metrics.description: For semisimple Lie algebra L, returns a string describing the types of the simple summands of L (e.g., "B3 A1").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify decomposition into simple summands; often used after Levi–Malcev decomposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChevalleyBasis
rubrics_metrics.description: For semisimple L with split Cartan subalgebra, ChevalleyBasis(L) returns a list of three sublists forming a Chevalley basis: positive root vectors, negative root vectors, and Cartan elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for computations relying on Chevalley bases and root decompositions; example lists vectors returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRootSystem
rubrics_metrics.description: Category/test indicating an object is a root system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to distinguish root-system objects in GAP; many root-system-specific attributes depend on this category.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRootSystemFromLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Category/test for root systems that come from (semisimple) Lie algebras; such root systems often have extra attributes like UnderlyingLieAlgebra, PositiveRootVectors, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes root systems that are realizable from an actual Lie algebra instance.

rubrics_metrics.name: RootSystem
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the root system R of a semisimple Lie algebra L with split Cartan subalgebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result is a root-system object; follow-up functions can extract roots, vectors, Cartan matrix, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingLieAlgebra (for root systems)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a root system R coming from a semisimple Lie algebra L, UnderlyingLieAlgebra(R) returns that Lie algebra L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connects root-system objects to their originating Lie algebra in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: PositiveRoots / NegativeRoots
rubrics_metrics.description: PositiveRoots(R) and NegativeRoots(R) return lists of positive and negative roots of root system R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Roots are represented as lists (vectors) of integers corresponding to coordinates with respect to simple roots.

rubrics_metrics.name: PositiveRootVectors / NegativeRootVectors
rubrics_metrics.description: Return lists of non-zero root vectors in the Lie algebra corresponding bijectively to PositiveRoots(R) and NegativeRoots(R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each root vector is a nonzero element of the corresponding root space in the underlying Lie algebra.

rubrics_metrics.name: SimpleSystem
rubrics_metrics.description: SimpleSystem(R) returns a list of simple roots of the root system R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the reference ordering for Cartan matrix and other constructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CartanMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the Cartan matrix of root system R relative to the simple roots from SimpleSystem(R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cartan matrix entries are used in many constructions (e.g., canonical relations for generators).

rubrics_metrics.name: BilinearFormMat
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the matrix of the bilinear form on the root system R; B(i,j) = (alpha_i, alpha_j) for simple roots alpha_i.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for computing inner products of roots and weight lattice operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: For R from a semisimple Lie algebra L, returns 3l canonical generators x_i, y_i, h_i (grouped in three lists) satisfying standard Chevalley/Cartan relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relations: h_i*h_j = 0, x_i*y_j = delta_{i,j} h_i, h_j*x_i = c_{i,j} x_i, etc.; also hi acts on root vectors by entries of root coordinates.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsWeylGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Property test: a Weyl group is a group generated by reflections with attribute SparseCartanMatrix set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to validate group objects representing Weyl groups in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: SparseCartanMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: SparseCartanMatrix(W) returns a sparse representation of the Cartan matrix of the corresponding root system as a list of lists [j, C[i][j]] for nonzero entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Efficient representation for use with Weyl group and reflection operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: WeylGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: WeylGroup(R) returns the Weyl group of root system R, represented by matrices acting on weight lattice; generated by simple reflections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GeneratorsOfGroup(W) gives the simple reflections as matrices; weights are vectors of integers and action is via multiplication w*g.

rubrics_metrics.name: ApplySimpleReflection
rubrics_metrics.description: ApplySimpleReflection(SC, i, wt) applies the i-th simple reflection (with SC the sparse Cartan matrix) to the weight wt, modifying wt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in iterative procedures to conjugate weights into dominant chamber; example shows in-place modification of weight list.

rubrics_metrics.name: LongestWeylWordPerm
rubrics_metrics.description: LongestWeylWordPerm(W) returns the permutation sigma such that the longest Weyl group element g0 maps simple root alpha_i to -alpha_{sigma(i)}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives combinatorial data of the action of the longest element on simple roots.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConjugateDominantWeight / ConjugateDominantWeightWithWord
rubrics_metrics.description: ConjugateDominantWeight(W, wt) returns the unique dominant weight conjugate to wt under W; ConjugateDominantWeightWithWord also returns the list of simple reflections (word) applied to wt to reach it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The second form is useful to replay the sequence of reflections; examples show retrieving the dominant weight and the reflection word.

rubrics_metrics.name: WeylOrbitIterator
rubrics_metrics.description: WeylOrbitIterator(W, wt) returns an iterator over the orbit of weight wt under Weyl group W.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Iterator can be traversed with NextIterator and IsDoneIterator; example counts orbit size (size of Weyl group).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restricted Lie algebra definition / p-map representation
rubrics_metrics.description: A Lie algebra L over field characteristic p>0 is restricted if there is a p-map x -> x^{[p]} satisfying ad(x^{[p]}) = (ad x)^p, (alpha x)^{[p]} = alpha^p x^{[p]}, and (x+y)^{[p]} = x^{[p]} + y^{[p]} + sum_i s_i(x,y) (certain Lie polynomials). In GAP a p-map is stored as a list of images of basis vectors (an attribute of the basis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Knowing p-images of basis vectors suffices to compute p-images of all elements; PthPowerImages and PthPowerImage functions use this representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRestrictedLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: Test whether L is restricted (i.e., has a p-map defined).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows SimpleLieAlgebra("W",[2],GF(5)) is not restricted but another is.

rubrics_metrics.name: PthPowerImages
rubrics_metrics.description: For a basis B of a restricted Lie algebra, PthPowerImages(B) returns the list of images of the basis vectors under the p-map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute-based access to the stored p-map images; example returns list with many zero images.

rubrics_metrics.name: PthPowerImage (element / basis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes image of element x under p-map in three forms: PthPowerImage(B,x) using basis B that stores pth powers; PthPowerImage(x) for elements without predetermined basis; PthPowerImage(x,n) to iterate p-mapping n times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Second form is for Lie objects without basis (e.g., LieObject-wrapped elements); third form iterates p-map multiple times.

rubrics_metrics.name: JenningsLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: JenningsLieAlgebra(G) constructs the Jennings–Lie algebra of a nontrivial p-group G from its Jennings series Gi, with L = ⊕ Gi/Gi+1 as vector spaces and Lie bracket induced by group commutator; induced p-map and grading attribute are set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resulting Lie algebra is graded; PthPowerImages(B) attribute is set for canonical basis; example shows Grading attribute structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCentralLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: PCentralLieAlgebra(G) is analogous to JenningsLieAlgebra but uses the p-central series instead of Jennings series; returns a graded Lie algebra that may not be restricted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful alternative construction from p-groups; not guaranteed to have p-map.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismOfLieAlgebraFromNilpotentGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute attached to Lie algebras created by JenningsLieAlgebra or PCentralLieAlgebra: a map f such that for g in Gi, f(g,i) returns the corresponding element of L lying in i-th homogeneous component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit mapping from group elements (and series index) to Lie algebra elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: AdjointMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: AdjointMatrix(B,x) is the matrix of the adjoint representation of element x with respect to basis B; the i-th column describes image of i-th basis vector under left multiplication by x (ad_x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to form matrices for further linear algebra; example shows a 3×3 matrix for A1.

rubrics_metrics.name: AdjointAssociativeAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: AdjointAssociativeAlgebra(L,K) returns the associative matrix algebra (with 1) generated by the adjoint representation matrices of subalgebra K acting on L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to study representation generated by adjoint action of a subalgebra; examples show dimension differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: KillingMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: KillingMatrix(B) returns the matrix of the Killing form κ with respect to basis B, i.e., entries κ(b_i,b_j).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute orthogonals and test semisimplicity; example prints explicit matrix entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: KappaPerp
rubrics_metrics.description: KappaPerp(L, U) returns the orthogonal complement U^⊥ = { x in L : κ(x,y)=0 for all y in L } with respect to Killing form κ; if U is an ideal then U^⊥ is a subalgebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns vector space or subalgebra object; examples show obtaining one-dimensional complement.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNilpotentElement
rubrics_metrics.description: IsNilpotentElement(L,x) returns true if element x is nilpotent in L, i.e., its adjoint matrix is a nilpotent matrix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines nilpotency via linear algebra on AdjointMatrix; example returns true for basis vector.

rubrics_metrics.name: NonNilpotentElement
rubrics_metrics.description: NonNilpotentElement(L) returns a non-nilpotent element of L if L is not nilpotent (by Engel's theorem one exists), otherwise returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to find witness elements for non-nilpotency; example returns a basis vector for G2.

rubrics_metrics.name: FindSl2
rubrics_metrics.description: FindSl2(L,x) attempts to find a subalgebra S of L isomorphic to sl2 that contains the nilpotent element x; returns S if found else fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searches for embedding of sl2 containing given nilpotent; example shows success for G2.

rubrics_metrics.name: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra(L[,B]) returns the universal enveloping algebra U(L); if basis B provided, returns isomorphic copy generated by images of B; elements are in PBW basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GeneratorsOfAlgebraWithOne(UL) yields images of Lie generators; examples show nontrivial multiplications in U(L).

rubrics_metrics.name: Finitely presented Lie algebra construction (FL / [r_i])
rubrics_metrics.description: Finitely presented Lie algebras are constructed as quotient FL/[r1,...,rk] of a free Lie algebra by the ideal generated by relators r_i; if finite-dimensional, NiceAlgebraMonomorphism(K) returns a surjective homomorphism onto structure-constants algebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited computations with elements are possible even when algebra is infinite; examples show constructing a small finite-dimensional quotient and testing nilpotency.

rubrics_metrics.name: FpLieAlgebraByCartanMatrix
rubrics_metrics.description: FpLieAlgebraByCartanMatrix(C) returns the finitely-presented Lie algebra over rationals defined by Cartan matrix C; by Serre's theorem this is semisimple with root system having Cartan matrix C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One can then use NiceAlgebraMonomorphism to obtain explicit basis and determine SemiSimpleType of the range.

rubrics_metrics.name: NilpotentQuotientOfFpLieAlgebra
rubrics_metrics.description: NilpotentQuotientOfFpLieAlgebra(FpL, max[, weights]) computes the quotient of FpL by the (max+1)-th term of its lower central series (or by elements of weight max+1 if weights specified), returning surjective homomorphism onto the quotient algebra K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: weights assigns graded weights to generators (default is list of 1s); if relators are homogeneous the quotient is graded; example computes quotient of large max with specified weights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cochain representation for Lie algebra modules
rubrics_metrics.description: An s-cochain c : L^s -> V is skew-symmetric and represented by a list of r lists (r = dim V). Each j-th list has entries [[i1,...,is], lambda] for nonzero coefficients, storing only nonzero values. 0-cochains are represented as list [v_c].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Representation is sparse; example shows 2-cochain mapping and how it's encoded as nested lists; ExtRepOfObj returns this representation for cochain objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCochain / IsCochainCollection
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories/tests indicating whether an object is an s-cochain or a collection of cochains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to validate cochain-like objects before applying cohomology operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cochain(V, s, obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs an s-cochain with values in module V using data in obj; if s ≠ 0 then obj must be a list in the sparse representation format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For s=0 obj should be a single basis vector of V; ExtRepOfObj(c) returns the underlying list representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CochainSpace
rubrics_metrics.description: CochainSpace(V, s) returns the vector space of all s-cochains with respect to module V.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returned space has a basis of s-cochains accessible via Basis and BasisVectors; examples show dimension counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: ValueCochain
rubrics_metrics.description: ValueCochain(c, y1, ..., ys) returns the value of s-cochain c applied to elements y1,...,ys (or alternatively provide a list of arguments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to evaluate cochains on tuples of Lie algebra elements; examples illustrate returned module element.
